functionalMotif: Five different colored planetary disks arranged around one cyan circular ring, with a cyan center hub and three spokes.

oldSourceCondition: The original board has an opaque saturated magenta field. The legacy runtime was produced by the old crop/chroma/despill workflow and has softened colored boundaries; the paired-arm original particularly shows pale colored fringe. Intentional purple parts in the planet and downgrade motifs are not mislabeled as contamination. The verified grid crop contains the complete intended motif without observable clipping or neighboring-card bleed. Original board and runtime bytes are preserved; no old keyed pixels are reused in the generated master.
postprocessing: Exact source reference crop only. Generated artwork remains unchanged; no chroma key, alpha cleanup, recolor or pixel repainting.
legacyBuilderEvidence: The read-only build_final_scifi_v1.py chroma() function invokes remove_chroma_key.py, then additionally removes saturated magenta pixels; fit_transparent() crops to alpha bounds. This is historical provenance only. New previews use whole-canvas contain and preserve generated alpha.
semanticNotes: Exactly five planetary disks retain the verified positions and color identities: blue at top, green/blue at upper left, orange at upper right, beige/brown at lower left, and purple/gray at lower right. A single cyan outer ring joins all five, and a central blue/cyan hub has the original three spokes toward the top and two lower planets. Bounded accent diamonds/dots remain near the ring. Broad terrain patches and short flat highlights replace finer source texture. No extra planet, world label or invented connection route is added.
visualStyle: Approved chunky C02 broad matte planes and bold contour; original skill motif plus approved cargo-crate style-only reference.
